title: Gabriela Silang
summary: Born around 1723 in Santa, Ilocos Sur, and raised in Vigan, she married Diego Silang in 1757. After his assassination she took over leadership of the Ilocos Revolt, was captured by Spanish authorities and executed on 20 September 1763. A national historical marker calls her the first woman to lead a revolt in the Philippines.

uncertainty.note: The NHCP marker gives her birth only as "ca." 1723; the execution is dated to the day.

where.modern_name: Vigan, Ilocos Sur, Philippines (pinned to Vigan, where she grew up, where the NHCP marker to her stands and where Farrell places her hanging; she was born in Santa, Ilocos Sur)
where.historical_name: Vigan, Ilocos, under Spanish authority during the Ilocos Revolt (1762-63)

importance.justification: Described on an official Philippine marker as the first woman to lead a revolt in the Philippines.
